brief.purpose: A local-first co-creative product studio where designers and frontend builders work with AI to turn an early idea into an editable, runnable interface and keep refining it together
brief.concept: Three distinct bold creative strokes approach from different directions and meet to reveal a small radiant diamond in their shared negative space; each stroke remains individually visible while the combined silhouette becomes a new coherent mark, expressing diverse ideas, human-AI collaboration, inspiration, and creation. It may feel like a moment of ignition or an abstract opening bloom, but must not depict a literal flower, people, hands, speech bubbles, or a star. Avoid Slack-like four petals, recycling loops, loading spinners, pinwheels, corporate circles, documents, browser windows, robots, cursors, code brackets, and letterforms
brief.style: Original brand-identity logo, energetic and optimistic but professionally controlled; compact flat-vector mark with exactly three large shapes and one bold central negative-space event, distinctive outer silhouette, minimal geometry, clear at 16 px and viable as a one-color silhouette. No illustration scene, gradients, gloss, texture, thin lines, tiny details, shadows, app tile, text, or mockup
brief.palette: electric cobalt #3157E5, vivid coral #FF5C54, warm sun yellow #FFC43D, optional deep ink #1E2230; no green
